description.text: Objectives The program in Product Design and Art provides students with solid theory and knowledge of art, design, and digital media. Students will learn and understand new methods and new trends of visual art and design in China and abroad. Graduates from the program should be able to create visual design with modern art concepts, forms, and means. We encourage our students to be innovative and creative in working with professionals from different disciplines. Duration Duration of program is 2 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Industrial Product Design and Digitalization 2. Human-computer Interaction Design and Digitalization 3. Digital Design for Cultural-creative Products Credit Units Students need to successfully complete at least 41credits.

duration.text: The Product Design and Art at Harbin Institute of Technology(Shenzhen Campus) is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1) A copy of passport (the original passport will be checked during registration) 2) One passport-size photo (35mm*50mm) 3) Graduation certificate or Bachelor’s Degree 4) Bachelor’s Degree Transcript 5) Study Plan in Harbin Institute of Technology(Shenzhen Campus) 6) Two letters of recommendation from two associate professors or higher

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. 2. Be Healthy. 3. Under the age of 35. 4. Have attained a Bachelor's diploma with good marks. 5. Have solid financial support to afford the study and living expense in China. 6. Good English reading, writing and speaking skills.
